transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. Lately I keep jumping into big plans and trips without thinking, and it’s starting to cause some real problems for my family. They got so worried about my sudden decisions that they insisted I come in to get checked out.
Have you also been feeling unusually high, irritable, or full of energy lately, or having trouble sleeping because your mind is racing?

Yes, I've been swinging between feeling on top of the world, like I'm the only one who knows what needs to be done, to snapping at my wife or pastor over the smallest pushback. I'm also only sleeping a few hours a night but waking up buzzing with energy, pacing around the house and rearranging things because I physically cannot sit still.
Have you had previous episodes like this, where you felt extremely high or irritable for a week or more, or have your mood swings been happening repeatedly over the past few years?

No, I haven't really experienced anything like this before now. I've always been known as a warm, steady person until this past month when all of this started. This is completely new for me and my family.
Have you ever had a period of depression or low mood lasting more than two weeks, especially before or after these recent episodes of high energy and irritability?

No, I don't recall ever having a period of depression or low mood that lasted like that. My struggle has really been the opposite, especially lately with this intense energy and irritability that I just can't seem to control.
